select_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND DATE(o.order_delivered_customer_date) BETWEEN '2018-08-18' AND '2018-09-01' AND julianday(DATE(o.order_delivered_customer_date)) - julianday(DATE(o.order_estimated_delivery_date)) < 10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_payments AS p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.payment_type = 'voucher') AND (SELECT SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) FROM order_items AS i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id) <= 500 ORDER BY o.order_id LIMIT 1 OFFSET 60
